verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 has a dedicated snapshot/restore doc covering every part of the story. It describes checkpointing an initialized workspace, claiming new sandboxes from that filesystem state, rolling an existing sandbox back, and forking a running or paused sandbox. The coding-agents use case reinforces this by claiming parallel sandboxes from a snapshot ID. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that snapshot, restore and fork work as documented.
